WITH MonthlySales AS (
  SELECT 
    ib."name" AS "Brick Name", 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ms."invoice_date") AS "Month", 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ms."invoice_date") AS "Year", 
    SUM(ms."total_amount") AS "Total Sales"
  FROM "master_sale" ms
  JOIN "customer_details" cd ON ms."customer_id" = cd."customer_id"
  JOIN "ims_brick" ib ON cd."ims_brick_id" = ib."id"
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ms."invoice_date") = 2025
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
GOLM AS (
  SELECT 
    "Brick Name", 
    "Month", 
    "Year", 
    "Total Sales",
    LAG("Total Sales") OVER (PARTITION BY "Brick Name" ORDER BY "Year", "Month") AS "Prev Month Sales"
  FROM MonthlySales
)
SELECT 
  "Brick Name", 
  ("Total Sales" - "Prev Month Sales") / NULLIF("Prev Month Sales", 0) * 100 AS "GOLM%"
FROM GOLM
WHERE "Month" = 12 AND "Year" = 2025
ORDER BY "GOLM%" DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH Internal AS (
  SELECT 
    ib."name" AS "Brick Name", 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ms."invoice_date") AS "Month", 
    SUM(ms."product_quantity") AS "Sales Units"
  FROM "master_sale" ms
  JOIN "customer_details" cd ON ms."customer_id" = cd."customer_id"
  JOIN "ims_brick" ib ON cd."ims_brick_id" = ib."id"
  WHERE ib."name" ILIKE '%LIAQUATABAD BLOCK-4%' 
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ms."invoice_date") = 2025
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 
  "Brick Name", 
  "Month", 
  "Sales Units",
  LAG("Sales Units") OVER (ORDER BY "Month") AS "Previous Month Sales",
  ROUND(100.0 * ("Sales Units" - LAG("Sales Units") OVER (ORDER BY "Month")) / NULLIF(LAG("Sales Units") OVER (ORDER BY "Month"), 0), 2) AS "Growth %"
FROM Internal
WHERE "Month" IN (11, 12)
ORDER BY "Month";
